requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product name references for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent reference to minimize user confusion.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting the minimum print quality (PQ) specifications for each region.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate without hardware failure or input tray sensor flag breakage when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer continues to function without failure when tilted left and right up to 20 degrees during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and functionality when printing while placed on a trolley.
